resources.string: Connect an account only to execute CoinePro signals. Credentials travel to the server over HTTPS and are never stored by the app.

What you enter here is setup input, not proof of a connection. Connected state comes only from the server and the venue; if verification does not arrive, execution stays pending rather than being guessed locally.
Broker, server, account number and trading password are yours to provide. Saving them is not a successful MetaTrader connection; verification must come back from the server.
Create an LBank API key with only the permission you need: spot or futures. Withdrawal permission is not required. Saving a key does not mean the exchange has verified it.
Saved securely; the exchange has not verified it yet. Execution stays queued until LBank confirms.
